title: Newly found mysterious sites in Eastern Turkey

tellings.quote: I stumbled ac across these very mysterious sites that were brand new

plain: In eastern Turkey, in the Ararat region that was once part of Armenia, there are said to be very mysterious ancient sites that had only just been found. The researcher Matt LaCroix, who writes about lost ancient history, says he "stumbled across" them himself. He tells it because such sites could point to a forgotten chapter of human history.
